newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Man reported shot in Belgrade fighting.
newsitem.headline: Man reported shot in Belgrade fighting.

text.p: Demonstrators claimed a young man was shot in the head as government and opposition supporters fought in central Belgrade on Tuesday before riot police separated them.
Independent Radio Index said there were unofficial reports that he had been killed.
A doctor at the city emergency centre confirmed that a man had been shot but did not know his condition.
Eyewitness Borivoje Spasojevic told Reuters that men walking among a group of socialist supporters of President Slobodan Milosevic pulled out guns.

One shot was fired in the air and a second hit a young man in the head. He collapsed with blood streaming from the wound but Spasojevic did not know whether he was killed. The man who fird escaped into the crowd.
Five weeks of opposition protests against socialist election fraud have been peaceful until Tuesday when street fighting erupted between rival groups of demonstrators.
